component.name: Stack
component.description: Generic vertical-rhythm primitive — a flex column with a configurable gap between children. Use anywhere vertical spacing needs to be consistent: page bodies, card content, sections inside Main/Aside, SidePanel content.

useCases: Vertical spacing between sections inside a page body
Spacing between cards, panels, or content blocks in a column
Vertical layout inside SidePanel.content (the system primitive in place of PageLayout there)
Inside PageLayout.Main or PageLayout.Aside to add consistent rhythm between groups

commonPatterns.name: default
commonPatterns.description: Default md gap (24px) for general section spacing

commonPatterns.name: tight
commonPatterns.description: sm gap (16px) for closely related items

antiPatterns.scenario: Using Stack to lay out horizontal content
antiPatterns.reason: Stack is intentionally vertical-only; it's a single-axis primitive.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use a flex row directly, or compose with the appropriate horizontal layout primitive.

antiPatterns.scenario: Using <div className="flex flex-col gap-6"> instead of Stack
antiPatterns.reason: Reinvents the primitive with arbitrary gap values, drifting away from the system's spacing scale.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use <Stack gap="md"> — same output, consistent across the system.

responsive.mobile: Same vertical layout — gap stays consistent
responsive.desktop: Same vertical layout — gap stays consistent

accessibility.role: Generic container — no special ARIA roles needed
accessibility.screenReader: Transparent to screen readers — passes through children

rules: Default gap is md (24px) — fits most section-to-section rhythm
Use sm (16px) for closely related items, lg (32px) for major section breaks
Stack is vertical-only — for horizontal layouts, use flex utilities directly
Stack does not constrain width — pair with PageContainer or PageLayout when width control is needed

aiHints.context: Stack is the system's standard vertical-rhythm primitive. Reach for it whenever you would otherwise write <div className="flex flex-col gap-X">. Most useful inside SidePanel content (where PageLayout is forbidden — see LC-001), inside Main/Aside slots of a two-column PageLayout, or as the body of any page.
